notes.title: Small bug patch (1.18.1)
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added more fall backs to spawning system to keep it running smoothly.
[/list]
Small fixes for the spawning system. This should help keep the spawn system running smoothly even if it encounters any issues or if it struggles to initialize after migrating server host.

Thank you to anyone who has reported a bug recently! These reports help me make Cryptid Farm the best it can be 😄 I'll keep trying to be vigilant for any bugs or issues that appear and try to get fixes out as quickly as possible.

- FistFlame

notes.title: Small bug patch (1.17.8)
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed "Player Total" setting.
[*] Fixed "UI scale" setting.
[*] Fixed some additional menu issues.
[/list]
Hello again! Some more small fixes in this update. The "Player Total" option wasn't working as expected which is now fixed. Also, the "UI scale" display option has been fixed to be functional in this update. If you ever thought the in-game UI was too large or small, you can now adjust its scale using this option (though it is still an experimental option for the time being).

That's all for now, thanks for reading!
- FistFlame

notes.title: Small bug patch (1.17.7)
notes.notes:
Changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a very rare shop bug.
[*] Very slightly reduced Chupacabra volume.
[*] Fixed a few small menu issues.
[/list]
Hello Cryptid Farmers! I hope you're all doing great. Just a small patch for now, more good things are still on the way 👍 This shop keeper bug blew my mind when I saw it happen on a live stream recently. Instead of leaving for 100 seconds, the shopkeeper had left for multiple real time days! Should be all fixed now.

Thanks for reading!
- FistFlame

notes.title: Post-launch patch (1.17.4)
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Enabled use of the pause key to exit from various menus.
[*] Added prompt to the tractor to help guide players when they have tractor parts in their inventory.
[*] Disabled UI hiding debug button.
[/list]

Just a few small changes that I think make the experience easier for new players.

I just wanted to mention how blown away I am by the recent game activity. Thank you everyone for taking an interest in Cryptid Farm! I'd also like to thank the YouTubers Dead Squirrel, H20Delirous, CaRtOoNz and Kyle for their recent videos on the game. Check out their channels if you have a moment!

My next development goal will likely be to do with upgrading the current server solutions.

Thanks for reading! 😄
- FistFlame

notes.title: Halloween patch (1.17.3)
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added fan submitted pumpkins for Halloween 2024.
[*] Added credits for the fans that submitted a design this year.
[/list]

Happy Halloween! This is just a small patch to add some extra pumpkin fan designs that were submitted in the Cryptid Farm discord server (the "pumpkin patch" if you will!). These new designs have been added to the overall pool of designs which you may see in game!

Wanted to submit a design? I'm still happy to receive pumpkin designs in the Cryptid Farm discord or at the Cryptid Farm email: cryptidfarm@gmail.com .

Future patches will likely focus on some quality of life changes for the UI and tractor fixing, hopefully meaning less hassle with closing menus.

Thanks for reading and have a spooky day!
- FistFlame

notes.title: Launch patch 3 (1.17.2)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Additional fixes for achievements (specifically for "The sound of forgiveness" achievement).
[*] Create server menu now creates private servers by default.
[*] Mothman tracking code updated for non-host clients.
[*] Chupacabra failsafe added for non-host clients reaching the safe area.
[/list]

Thank you once again for your patience whilst I fix the achievements still, this should hopefully be the last needed update for these, but please let me know if anything seems off.

I hope everyone's been having fun with the game! It still doesn't feel real to have released onto Steam. The launch has been very successful (despite the needed updates) and I've been happy to see so many people playing :)

Thanks for reading!
- FistFlame

notes.title: Launch patch 2 (1.17.1)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Identified broken achievements and made fixes to their code. These should be working much better now, thank you for your patience with this.
[/list]
Release weekend is almost over and it's been a blast! Thanks for all of your continued support.
Please let me know if you encounter any further issues!

[i]- FistFlame[/i]
